requirements.title: Stripe environment config
requirements.description: Each landing page includes Stripe keys from environment variables

requirements.title: Stripe routes
requirements.description: Each landing page includes routes for creating checkout sessions and handling webhook events

requirements.title: Webhook signature verification
requirements.description: All webhook endpoints verify Stripe signature before processing

requirements.title: Subscription verification endpoint
requirements.description: Each landing page exposes GET /api/subscription/verify accepting user identity, returning active/inactive/trial/canceled

requirements.title: Verification caching
requirements.description: Subscription verification responses cacheable (short TTL) with max 60s lag from webhook changes

requirements.title: Subscription cancellation endpoint
requirements.description: API exposes POST /api/subscription/cancel validating user and returning status

requirements.title: Plan listing & checkout orchestration
requirements.description: Parse Stripe product/price metadata (tiers, intro pricing, billing_interval, plan_rank, bundle_key) and expose PricingService.GetPricing plus POST /api/v1/billing/create-checkout-session|create-credits-checkout-session and GET /api/v1/billing/portal-url that respect $1 intro month rules, weights, and deterministic slugs.

validation.notes: PlanService tests validate monthly/yearly tier ordering and lookup by Stripe price.
PlanService loads bundle metadata, sorts tiers, and exposes lookups used by /plans.

requirements.title: Credits + pricing display
requirements.description: Expose AccountService.GetMySubscription and AccountService.GetMyCredits that convert internal credits_per_usd to display_credits_multiplier/label, include included credits + bonuses per plan, and surface upgrade CTAs for logged-in visitors.

validation.notes: AccountService credits test confirms bundle multipliers and labels are surfaced.
AccountService reads bundle metadata and exposes credits via /me/credits.

requirements.title: Bundled app entitlement API
requirements.description: Provide AccountService.GetEntitlements returning plan tier, feature flags, billing-cycle metadata, and credit metrics for bundled apps. Responses must cache briefly (≤60s) and support offline degradation with short-lived storage for the bundled clients.

validation.notes: Entitlements test ensures features/credits/subscription status reflect bundle metadata.
AccountService exposes entitlements with cached subscription lookups and metadata.

requirements.title: Download gating + analytics
requirements.description: Landing config includes download sections that expose platform installers + release notes sourced from S3 (or equivalent) but keep buttons disabled until the entitlement API confirms an active subscription; download attempts emit variant_id + plan metadata for analytics.

validation.notes: The delivery domain enforces paid-asset entitlement gating; API composition supplies the account entitlement lookup.
